issues.description: Behavior change: empty base_image fallback now forces python:3.12 instead of kfp default image
issues.detail: In pipeline.py _set_base_image, the fallback was self.base_image = "" with a comment 'Use kfp default image'. Replacing it with DEFAULT_BASE_IMAGE (python:3.12) silently changes runtime behavior for users who previously relied on the kfp-provided default. This is a behavioral regression unrelated to the UI feature and should be documented or split out.

issues.description: DEFAULT_BASE_IMAGE constant duplicated and hardcoded in TypeScript fallback paths
issues.detail: DEFAULT_BASE_IMAGE = 'python:3.12' is duplicated in CellMetadataEditor.tsx and as a hardcoded fallback in Commands.ts getDefaultBaseImage. This defeats the point of the RPC (single source of truth in Python). If the Python default ever changes, the TS fallback string will silently disagree. Consider returning the value once and threading it through, with no string fallback.

issues.description: Button labeled IMAGE with width 5% is unclear and likely visually broken
issues.detail: The previous Input clearly showed 'Base Image' and current value inline. The replacement is a small contained button labeled 'IMAGE' with style width: '5%' inside a div, which will render as a tiny button with truncated/awkward text and hides the current value from the row. This is a UX regression for an inline editor; at minimum show the current image next to the button.

issues.description: Base image button disabled when stepName empty silently blocks editing
issues.detail: The new IMAGE button is disabled unless stepName has length > 0. The prior Input had no such gate, so users editing a fresh step lose the ability to set a base image until they name the step, with no tooltip or explanation. Either remove the disable or surface a tooltip/help text explaining the requirement.

issues.description: Inline import of DEFAULT_BASE_IMAGE inside RPC function is unnecessary
issues.detail: get_default_base_image performs a local 'from kale.pipeline import DEFAULT_BASE_IMAGE' on every call. compiler.py already imports it at module top. The function should import at module scope for consistency and a marginal perf improvement; the local import suggests avoidance of a circular import that doesn't actually exist here.

issues.description: createBaseImageText always renders even with no step, changing layout for non-step cells
issues.detail:
Previously createBaseImageText returned '' when baseImage was unset. Now it always returns a

with 'Base Image: python:3.12 (default)'. If InlineMetadata is rendered for cells without a step assignment, this will add a stray base-image line where none appeared before. Confirm this only renders for step cells, or gate by cellType.

review.summary: The PR adds a default base image (python:3.12) shared between backend and labextension, surfaces it in the cell metadata UI via a new dialog, and threads the value down through several React components. The most material concern is an unintended behavioral change in pipeline.py where the empty-string fallback (which deferred to the kfp default image) is replaced with a hardcoded python:3.12 — that's a runtime regression unrelated to the UI feature. On the frontend, the new IMAGE button has poor affordance (5% width, label hides current value, silently disabled when stepName empty), and the DEFAULT_BASE_IMAGE constant is duplicated in TypeScript despite the new RPC, which undermines the single-source-of-truth goal. A couple of smaller nits around the inline import and unconditional render of the base-image text round it out.
